 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJIV ROY  ORAL ORDER 2 22-05-2023 Heard Mr. D.K. Sinha, learned Senior Counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

The petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Mahila P.S. Case No. 05 of 2022 for the offence registered under sections 376, 506 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code lodged on 21.01.2022 by the informant, Preeti Kumari.

Prosecution case in brief is that the informant had friendship with the petitioner since 2015 and after lapse of some period, the petitioner offered for marriage where upon she asked the petitioner for consent of family members of petitioner.
The family members of petitioner assured that marriage will be solemnized in next 2-3 years.
Thereafter, the petitioner and the informant became live in partner and thus also had sexual Patna High Court CR.
dt.22-05-2023 relation.

In the year 2018-19 she appeared in the Intermediate exam and again in the month of July 2021, while she met with the petitioner in marriage ceremony in house of maternal uncle, there too they established sexual relationship.
Now, brother of petitioner namely, Jai Ram Singh, Lal Bahadur Singh, Manoj Singh, his mother Nanki Kuer as also one Pinki Devi, Pushpa Devi refused to solemnize the marriage.
Accordingly, the FIR.

sentences.text: Learned Senior Counsel has taken this Court to Annexure-2 to the petition to show that subsequently an affidavit has been preferred by the informant exonerating the petitioner of the charges.
Per contra, learned APP submits that under section 164 of the Cr.P.C., the lady has supported the prosecution story.
In the aforesaid contrasting statements made by the informant, it would be appropriate to hear the lady before passing an appropriate order.
Learned Senior Counsel for the petitioner prays for and is permitted to implead the informant as opposite party no. 2 in course of the day.

Issue notice to the newly added opposite party no. 2 under both processes i.e. ordinary as well as registered post with A.D. for which requisites etc. must be filed within one week Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.3215 of 2023(2) dt.22-05-2023 after summer vacation failing which the application shall stand rejected without further reference to the Bench.
List this case after service of notice and/or appearance of the opposite party no. 2 whichever is earlier.

In the meantime, no coercive steps be taken against the petitioner in connection with Mahila P.S.
Case No. 05 of 2022 pending in the Court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Rohtas at Sasaram.
